breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not repeat the incorrect claim that torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. Instead, it explicitly instructs calculating outer-surface torsional shear stress τ = T*c/J and using τxy = τ in plane stress, which matches the ground truth handling.
